note: Dendermonde: late-medieval brick wall with four gates (Jacob van Deventer c. 1565), modernised into a bastioned fortress from 1577-78 (Sanderus 1641 shows the 17th-c. form); traced from the Ferraris map (1777) along the main rampart. The Dender runs through the town into the Schelde on the north side; the Waaslandpoort is a bridgehead over the Schelde.
source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Dendermonde' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140019)
